free_tier.stated: No standing free text allowance on this page; model usage is billed per token (e.g. deepseek-flash cache-miss input USD 0.15 per 1M tokens off-peak, USD 0.3 peak).

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: OpenAI-compatible SDKs and the vendor's own API
chaining: charged per token, so any free credit must come from a separate promotion not published here

limits.value: per-token billing; no free tier stated

identity_cost.detail: an API key is issued by the platform; the pricing page states no card or phone gate

reliability_note: off-peak rates are half of peak rates; concurrency limit 2500 for deepseek-flash and 500 for deepseek-v4-pro

evidence.proved: models are billed per million tokens with a peak/off-peak split and a concurrency limit
evidence.quote: Model prices are listed in units of per 1M tokens.

notes: No free text allowance in the pricing page. A 'granted balance' is mentioned in deduction rules but its origin and size are not stated.
